OUT: calculated result + CALC id

READ ME · DECISION-OUTCOME-LEARNING SPECIALIST (read left to right)
1 Start
2 Check access
3 Check the outcome with SAP data
4 Final report

What it answers: Was a past recommendation right? Compares the prediction with what really happened in SAP.
Approval: none (report only). It never writes to SAP.

data.description: Add notes to the agent flow

inputs.note:
DECISION OUTCOME LEARNING SPECIALIST

SAP S/4HANA ERP APIs it queries (illustration; Phase 1 = synthetic snapshot via SCInsight /api/v1/sap/*):
- API_MATERIAL_DOCUMENT_SRV: goods receipts (actual outcome)
- API_PURCHASEORDER_PROCESS_SRV: executed PO

Calculation: GET /decisions/{id} + POST /outcomes/reconcile + GET /learning/metrics
Approval: none (report only)
Read-only: never writes to SAP.
